purpose: Teach: まとっ/ゆるやか/すえ/這い/とどまり/取り除い/くわしく/やしない

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、メイ姉さんが穏やかな雰囲気をまとってるね
lines.en: Sho, you've noticed how calm I feel right now, haven't you?
lines.style: Warm, observant. Gentle direct address to the child. Soft tone that invites him into a quiet moment. Slight smile in the voice.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、ゆるやかな坂をスケーターで降りたよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I rode my skateboard down the gentle slope today!
lines.style: Bright, unguarded pride. Quick delivery, eager to share. Small-voiced but completely unselfconscious. The joy of accomplishment shown, not performed.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、メイ姉さんがお話のすえに「またね」と言って下さったわ
lines.en: Sho, and when we finished talking, Mei-sis said goodbye to you.
lines.style: Soft, reflective. Lingering slightly on the goodbye, as if replaying the moment. Tender recollection—noticing what mattered to him about it.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、芝生を這いずって虫を観察したよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I crawled through the grass and watched the bugs today!
lines.style: Excited whisper. Quick, genuine enthusiasm. The words tumble out because he can't hold them in. Natural, unfiltered child delight.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、メイ姉さんと公園にもう少しとどまりたいわね
lines.en: Sho, I wish we could stay a little longer in the park together.
lines.style: Wistful, wanting to linger. Slow pace. A touch of reluctance to let the moment end. Warmth underneath—not sad, just reluctant.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、絵の余分な線を取り除いて綺麗にしたよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I cleaned up my drawing by removing the extra lines!
lines.style: Matter-of-fact pride. Direct, clear delivery. The quiet satisfaction of doing something right. No boasting—just stating fact with small confidence.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、メイ姉さん、お絵描きのコツをくわしく教えてあげる
lines.en: Sho, I'll teach you the tricks to drawing well—all the details.
lines.style: Gentle authority. Patient, like offering a small gift. Warm and present. The offer made simply, no fanfare—just opening a door for him.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お小遣いをやしないに少しずつ貯めるよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I'm going to save up my allowance little by little.
lines.style: Quiet determination. Thoughtful, like he's made a real decision. Small voice but steady. The seriousness of a child who means what he says.
